notes.title: The Matrix - "The One" scene roleplay in IgKnight Food Fight
notes.notes:
Happy 20th Anniversary to the Matrix! 

With our latest power up in our game IgKnight Food Fight, we were able to reenact the scene "The One" from the Matrix. One of the films that introduced us to Virtual Reality. Check it out below!

https://youtu.be/Bde3S9gOnLE
